This is the Gaza Dispatch audio briefing for July 24, 2026.

Here are the key source-backed developments from today's edition.

1. Four Palestinians killed as Israeli settlers raid occupied West Bank town. One Israeli was also killed near town of Tal in Nablus, according to Israel's Magen David Adom rescue services. This was reported by Al Jazeera.

2. Four Palestinians and one Israeli killed in West Bank shooting. Palestinians say villagers came under attack by settlers, while the Israeli military says a Palestinian stole a weapon and opened fire on hikers. This was reported by BBC News.

For the full source-backed dispatch, read the July 24, 2026 Gaza edition at dispatches.thebluefernco.com.
